title: Composable editorial suggestions
description:
## Intent

As a publication operator or AI-assisted editor, I want Limatus to expose diagnostics and optional rewrite suggestions as composable tools, so I can use them in the editorial process that fits the model and editor rather than follow a workflow prescribed by Limatus.

## Done when

- Diagnose remains useful on its own: it returns structured findings, annotations, and style context without requiring any subsequent command.
- An optional suggestion primitive can use a draft, portable style profile, diagnostic annotations, and reference samples to return reviewable rewrite candidates.
- The caller may provide selected findings or extra guidance to focus a request, but neither is required and neither dictates the candidate shape.
- Suggestions include rationale, unresolved questions, factual-verification warnings, and a reviewable diff.
- The source draft is never changed. Apply, diff, verification, and provenance are independent tools a caller may use or omit.
- No command requires a finding-level decision record, a particular edit order, auto-apply, or publishing.

## Gherkin

Feature: Composable editorial suggestions
  Scenario: Request an optional rewrite suggestion
    Given a draft, portable style profile, and diagnostic annotations
    When a caller invokes the suggestion tool
    Then Limatus returns reviewable candidates with rationale and a diff
    And the source draft remains unchanged

  Scenario: Focus without prescribing a process
    Given a draft and optional finding guidance
    When a caller invokes the suggestion tool
    Then the guidance informs the candidates without requiring a decision record
    And the caller may use the candidate with or without other Limatus tools

## Out of scope

An enforced editorial workflow, unattended rewriting, auto-apply, auto-publish, and detector-score optimization.
